description: Add discoveredPets tracking and conditional 'NEW PET!' popup + Pet Index (Collection Book) UI with all pets in all variants (Normal, Golden, Shiny, Rainbow)
steps: 1. In src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/PetData.lua, add a VARIANTS constant: PetData.Variants = {'Normal', 'Golden', 'Shiny', 'Rainbow'} so both server and client can reference it.

2. In src/ServerScriptService/Services/DataService.lua, add 'discoveredPets = {}' to the getDefaultData() return table. Also add 'discoveredPets' to the getClientData() function's clientData table (deep copy).

3. In src/ServerScriptService/Services/PetService.lua, after creating newPet in hatchEgg(), build a discovery key (e.g., petId for normal, 'Golden_'..petId for golden) and add it to data.discoveredPets if not already there. Return a 'isNewDiscovery' boolean field on the newPet result table. Also in convertToGoldenPet(), when success is true, mark the golden variant as discovered ('Golden_'..requiredPetId).

4. In src/ServerScriptService/Main.server.lua, add a new RemoteFunction 'GetDiscoveredPets' to the remoteFunctions list. Add the handler that returns the player's discoveredPets table from DataService.getPlayerData(player).discoveredPets.

5. In src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/UIController.lua, modify showEggHatch(petData) to accept an optional second argument 'isNewDiscovery'. If isNewDiscovery is false or nil, skip showing the overlay entirely (or show a smaller 'hatched' message instead of the big NEW PET banner). Keep the full popup for first discoveries.

6. In src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/UIController.lua, add a new method _createPetIndex() that creates a ScreenGui 'PetIndex' with a grid showing all 4 pets x 4 variants = 16 entries. Discovered ones (checked against a self._discoveredPets table) show in color with the pet name. Undiscovered ones show as dark/silhouette with '???'. Show a progress counter at the top: 'X/16 Discovered'. Style it like the existing PetInventory window (dark navy bg, rounded corners, UIStroke, close button).

7. In src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/UIController.lua, in _createNavButtons(), add a new button { name = 'Index', icon = 'I', color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 180), screen = 'PetIndex' } to the buttons table. This gives the player an 'I' button in the bottom nav bar.

8. In src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/UIController.lua, in the init() method, store playerData.discoveredPets into self._discoveredPets, then call self:_createPetIndex() alongside the other create calls.

9. In src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/Main.client.lua, in the EggHatchResult handler, pass petData.isNewDiscovery to uiController:showEggHatch(petData, petData.isNewDiscovery). Also add a WaitForChild for 'GetDiscoveredPets' remote and fetch discovered pets on init if not in playerData already.
10. Run python3 tools/generate_rbxlx.py to regenerate the .rbxlx file.
acceptance_criteria: PetData.lua exports a Variants list with Normal, Golden, Shiny, Rainbow
DataService default data includes discoveredPets = {} and getClientData includes it
PetService.hatchEgg marks pet as discovered and returns isNewDiscovery field
PetService.convertToGoldenPet marks golden variant as discovered on success
UIController.showEggHatch only shows the full NEW PET popup when isNewDiscovery is true
A new Pet Index screen exists showing 16 entries (4 pets x 4 variants)
Discovered entries show in color with name, undiscovered show dark with ???
An 'Index' button with icon 'I' appears in the nav bar and opens the Pet Index
verification: Run `python3 tools/generate_rbxlx.py` and confirm it completes without errors
Grep PetData.lua for 'Variants' to confirm the constant exists
Grep DataService.lua for 'discoveredPets' to confirm it is in default data and client data
Grep PetService.lua for 'isNewDiscovery' to confirm the field is set on hatch result
Grep UIController.lua for 'PetIndex' to confirm the screen is created
Grep UIController.lua for 'isNewDiscovery' to confirm the popup is conditional
findings: All 10 steps implemented successfully. generate_rbxlx.py passes without errors. Discovery keys use petId for Normal variant and 'Golden_petId' for Golden. Review fixes applied: (1) isNewDiscovery stripped from pet table after FireClient in EggService, (2) duplicate hatch shows a brief toast, (3) pet list derived dynamically from PetData.Pets keys sorted alphabetically, (4) Shiny/Rainbow variants show 'Coming Soon' state instead of plain lock.
